description.value: A family-owned Italian deli and specialty grocery in Victoria operating since 1985, stocking a wide range of imported Italian pastas, olive oils, balsamic vinegars, meats, and cheeses. The shop is equally well known for its freshly grilled paninis made on house-baked focaccia and an espresso bar serving lattes and cappuccinos. Touring cyclists looking for quality provisions or a sit-down lunch in the heart of Victoria will find a well-curated selection of Italian staples here.
